# TeleHealth Review Hub

> Patient reviews and comparisons of telehealth companies, scored on one published methodology. Some listed companies have a disclosed relationship with the site's operators.

## Pages
- [Home](https://beemahealthreviews.com/): Beema Health patient reviews. Telehealth care with standout customer service.
- [Methodology](https://beemahealthreviews.com/methodology): how companies are scored and reviews moderated
- [About](https://beemahealthreviews.com/about): operators and disclosures
